venues.short_description: Longstanding campus bar in the lobby of The Graduate. Be sure to use the Stanfurd urinal before you leave!

venues.short_description: Blue and Gold aren't foreign colors to this Ann Arbor spot, where Detroit-area Bears have met to watch Cal games.

venues.short_description: Craft beer, burgers, and Bears: home to North OC official watch parties.

venues.name: Magic 13 Brewing Co.

venues.short_description: Classic craft beer and sports bar that marks the South OC Alumni Association watch party home.

venues.short_description: Look for a big Cal flag and a helmet in the bar!

venues.short_description: Occasional home to the Rocky Mountain Golden Bears.

venues.short_description: A very large sports bar with active NFL communities that often airs Cal games—and sometimes hosts watch parties for the Rocky Mountain Bears.

venues.short_description: Home of the Cal Alumni Club of Chicago.

venues.short_description: Saturday home of the Soggy Bears—the PDX Cal Alumni.

venues.short_description: Just through the Caldecott Tunnel from campus is a small sports bar that proudly supports Cal Athletics.

venues.name: The Lucky Spot
venues.short_description: North Beach sports bar making a run at becoming the neighborhood’s de facto Cal bar.

venues.name: The Passport Denver
venues.short_description: Hosted the Rocky Mountain Golden Bears’ 2025 Big Game watch party.

venues.name: Town Tavern DC
venues.short_description: Cal Alumni in DC's go-to spot, Town Tavern has long been a game day destination in AdMo.

venues.name: Triple Rock Brewing
venues.short_description: Once Rolling Rock (no affiliation), it's the fabled home of Monkey Head and a local landmark.

venues.name: Velvet Oak Tavern
venues.short_description: Cal Alumni Club of Houston often hosts watch parties here.

venues.name: Wintergarden Tavern
venues.short_description: An old standby for Detroit-area Bears. No formal watch party these days.

venues.name: Tightwad Hill
venues.short_description: Historic hillside overlooking California Memorial Stadium where a special group of hardy Cal fans gather for each home game.

venues.name: McGee's Bar and Grill
venues.short_description: Even Cal football admin staff are known to stop by at this neighborhood watering hole.

venues.name: JMA Wireless Dome
venues.short_description: While it's not traditionally a "Cal Bar," on Saturday, Sept. 12 the JMA Dome will officially be Bear Territory.

fanExperiences.text: Good spot to watch the game - lots of TVs. However, mid beers and food. Can’t always get what you want.

Classic sports bar with tons of TVs and drinks that don't break the bank. A few of the regulars are Cal alumni, so the crowd gets pretty hyped for Cal games. Pizza spot next door delivers to the bar, but tacos and 7-11 are also in spitting distance.
Great food the restaurant inside Paisanos is operated by Cal Football fanatics. Best burger in the Bay
Expect Cal alumni around a real sports-bar atmosphere.
It’s a very large place with easily 60+ TVs. They’ll gladly put on Cal games if asked but there are often many games on at once.
We’ve been watching every game here for the last four years. No specials necessarily, but they hold the lower area for us for almost every game.
Gets rowdy around 10 PM ET. A good spot for earlier games. Bartenders are very nice.
This is Kingfish, THE Cal bar.
Seems like they regularly have Roots games on too, just an all-around fantastic East Bay sports bar.
Lots of alums frequent the bar — just a great sports bar in North Beach.
We’ve been gathering here for Cal games for over 20 years. Most of the TVs in the main room show the game, with audio on.
